yomi: くろすおーばーしけん

description.ja: 同じ参加者が異なる介入を順番に受ける臨床試験デザインです。各参加者が自分自身の対照群となるため、個人差の影響を減らせる利点があります。介入間にはウォッシュアウト期間(休薬期間)を設けて前の介入の影響を消します。
description.en: A clinical trial design where the same participants receive different interventions in sequence. Each participant serves as their own control, reducing the impact of individual variability. A washout period is typically included between interventions to eliminate carryover effects.

usage.ja: 論文では「crossover design」「2×2 crossover trial」などと表記され、介入の順序効果を評価するため無作為割付が行われます。慢性疾患の短期的な症状改善を調べる研究や、栄養介入の研究でよく用いられます。
usage.en: Papers often describe this as 'crossover design' or '2×2 crossover trial' with randomization to control for order effects. Commonly used in studies examining short-term symptom improvement in chronic conditions or nutritional intervention research.

synonyms.ja: 交差試験、クロスオーバーデザインとも呼ばれます。対照群を別に設ける並行群間試験(parallel trial)と対比されます。キャリーオーバー効果(前の介入の影響が残ること)に注意が必要です。
synonyms.en: Also called crossover design or crossover study. Contrasted with parallel-group trials where different participants receive different interventions. Careful consideration of carryover effects (residual effects from previous intervention) is essential.
